## History

Violetta was a fictional friend imagined by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a little girl who lived in the echo valley near Mrs. Hammond's house. The two were imagined to be great friends during Anne's time living there.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043)_
